Ivy (Marketing): Heads-up: were shipping the LaunchSpark email next week. Need final segment rules, a compact resend, and demo-click routing. Draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/launchspark.

Noah (Growth): Suggested splits: 50% recent trials (<21d), 30% dormant trials (22-90d), 15% product users, 5% partners. Add engaged boost (+20%) for anyone who opened in 60d. 3% randomized holdback for lift.

Lina (Content): Ill shorten hero to one stat + 3 bullets. Draft subjects: "LaunchSpark: faster LLM inference" and "Ship LLM features with lower latency". Recommend 2x2 subject/preheader test.

Diego (Ops): ESP limits: safe burst 110k/hr. Seed 1k tomorrow 09:00 PT. Suppress lists: global_unsub, trial_opt_out, dedicated_customers. If hard bounces >1.5% pause and route remainder into a 72h drip. Ill export CSV tonight.

Noah (Growth): UTMs: utm_campaign=launchspark&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter. Conversion windows: demo 7d, docs 14d. Demo clicks with intent_score>=60 -> route to #sdr-inbound. Exclude AE-assigned accounts.

Ivy (Marketing): Action items: Lina finalize subjects + preheaders (EOD); Diego export suppression + run seed (today/tomorrow); Noah wire up A/B tests + UTMs (tomorrow AM).

campaign-bot: Workspace updated: "launchspark_newsletter". Review scheduled: tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Lina (Content): On it :white_check_mark:

Diego (Ops): Ill post seed metrics here after run.

Ivy (Marketing): Thanks team. Keep this thread for quick notes only; ping me for blockers. :rocket:
